LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexBoss.Landing.Warning: We do not have permission to land at the orbital facility housing the cerebrex. Landing without authorization will turn the entire mechanoid hive hostile. We should not act without sufficient preparation.
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexBoss.Discovery.Letter.Label: Cerebrex defenses upgraded
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexBoss.Discovery.Letter.Common:
We have confirmed that the cerebrex has completed a targeted defensive upgrade.

Compared with a standard model, it can call in mechanoid reinforcements, unleash wide-area electromagnetic pulses, and directly disrupt mechanitors' bandwidth control networks. Without sufficient spare bandwidth, controlled mechanoids may suffer identification errors as their connections are disrupted, or even temporarily fall out of control.

Be sure to prepare before attacking.
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexBoss.Discovery.Letter.Symbio:
Alliance intelligence indicates that the cerebrex has completed a targeted defensive upgrade.

In addition to further improving its overall protection, the cerebrex can now call in mechanoid reinforcements and unleash wide-area electromagnetic pulses. It can also directly disrupt mechanitors' bandwidth control networks. Without sufficient spare bandwidth, controlled mechanoids may suffer identification errors as their control connections are disrupted, or even temporarily fall out of control.

If you decide to attack, alliance members will send support forces in succession once the battle begins. This will be a difficult battle. Be sure to prepare thoroughly before launching the attack.
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexBoss.Discovery.Letter.Purge:
Our ongoing analysis of signals from the central mechanoid hive suggests that the cerebrex has completed a targeted defensive upgrade.

In addition to further strengthening its garrison's overall combat capability, the cerebrex can now call in mechanoid reinforcements and unleash wide-area electromagnetic pulses. It can also directly disrupt mechanitors' bandwidth control networks. Without sufficient spare bandwidth, controlled mechanoids may suffer identification errors as their control connections are disrupted, or even temporarily fall out of control.

These upgrades undoubtedly make direct combat with the cerebrex even more dangerous. If we ever decide to take up arms against it, we must be fully prepared.
